text: {"findings":[{"rule":"K3","where":"Deployment._deployClaimIssuer","severity":"HIGH","why":"The override calls ctr.removeClaimTopic(KYC_TOPIC) after the base setup added the KYC topic, which leaves the ClaimTopicsRegistry with zero required claim topics. The policy requires at least one.","steps":"Deployment.setUp() -> ClaimTopicsRegistry.getClaimTopics() returns an empty array"},{"rule":"K1","where":"IdentityRegistry.isVerified","severity":"HIGH","why":"With no required claim topics, isVerified returns true as soon as the wallet has any identity contract, with no KYC claim and no trusted issuer checked. Token.transfer, transferFrom and mint then accept such wallets.","steps":"agent: ir.registerIdentity(x, new Identity(x), INDIA) (x has no claim) -> agent: token.mint(x, 100) or holder: token.transfer(x, 100) succeeds"},{"rule":"K2","where":"IdentityRegistry.isVerified","severity":"HIGH","why":"Because the topic list is empty, isVerified never reads claims, so revoking the KYC claim has no effect. A wallet whose KYC was revoked can still receive tokens.","steps":"claimIssuer.revokeClaim(claimId, idC or idA) -> transfer(wallet, 100) from any holder still succeeds"}]}
